mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_run SET status = #{status}, summary = #{summary}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'WAITING_PERMISSION') THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId}
